about: Single source of truth for every visual asset. Prompt files in assets/prompts/ are GENERATED from this file by tools/assets/build-prompts.mjs — edit here, then run `npm run assets:prompts`.
draft: Preliminary list derived from the simulation backend. Names, characters and story illustrations will be revised when the lore arrives.

statuses.awaiting-generation: Prompt is ready. No image exists yet.
statuses.awaiting-lore: Cannot be specified properly until the lore document arrives.
statuses.received: Raw image is in assets/incoming/, not yet processed.
statuses.processed: Cleaned, sliced and saved under assets/art/, not yet wired into the game.
statuses.integrated: Loaded and drawn by the game.
statuses.final: Integrated, checked on screen, approved by the team.

canvas.note: The game draws at 480x270 logical pixels and scales up by a whole number (x3 = 1440x810, x4 = 1920x1080).

assets.title: Style anchor — the whole base in one picture
assets.purpose: Defines the look of the entire game. Every other asset is generated with this image attached as the style reference. Not used in the game itself (it may become the title screen).
assets.perspective: Side view, flat orthographic cutaway (like an ant farm): no perspective, no vanishing point.
assets.generate: 16:9, the largest size the tool offers (e.g. 1920x1080)
assets.background: opaque
assets.subject: A small crewed Mars base shown as a cross-section through the ground. TOP THIRD: butterscotch-tan daytime Martian sky with a small pale sun, two layers of distant rust-coloured mesas. On the surface line, left to right: a field of four tilted blue solar panels with a little dust on them and a six-wheeled rover parked beside them; a short cylindrical airlock with a round hatch; a low white habitat module with a ladder hatch in its floor; a glass-and-white greenhouse module with rows of green plants under pinkish grow-lights; a white command module with a dish antenna on its roof. MIDDLE THIRD, underground, under a visible layer of reddish soil about one room-height thick: a wide crew-quarters room with four bunks; a vertical ladder shaft; a galley with a table, stools and an exercise bike; a life-support room with tanks, pipes and a glowing teal oxygen machine. BOTTOM THIRD, deeper, under a much thicker layer of soil with rocks and a pocket of pale ice: a wide storm shelter with benches, lockers and stacked water containers; the ladder shaft continuing down; a science lab with a workbench, microscope and sample boxes; a battery room with rows of battery cabinets with small amber lights. Four small astronauts about one third of a room tall: one in a white EVA suit with helmet standing by the solar panels, one in a jumpsuit tending plants, one climbing the ladder, one working at the lab bench. Rooms have cream walls, rounded corners, a thin grey metal frame, warm ceiling lights. The soil between rooms shows horizontal strata and small stones. Cozy, tidy, believable.
assets.layout: One full scene, edge to edge. Rooms arranged on a regular grid: 5 columns, 3 rows (1 on the surface, 2 underground), with the ladder shaft as the middle column.
assets.notes: Generate several candidates and choose ONE together. Everything else copies its palette, pixel size, outline and lighting, so this choice is the important one.

assets.title: Astronaut, indoor jumpsuit — sprite sheet
assets.purpose: The crew inside the base: every indoor activity the simulation has (idle, walk, work, eat, sleep, exercise, climb).
assets.perspective: Side view, character facing right. The game mirrors it for facing left.

frames.order: row 1: idle x2, walk x4 | row 2: walk x2 (continuing the cycle to 6), work standing at a console x4 | row 3: sitting and eating x2, sleeping lying down x2, exercising on a bike x2 | row 4: climbing a ladder seen from the side x4, cheering x2

assets.background: transparent, or solid #FF00FF if transparency is not available
assets.subject: One small friendly astronaut in a simple short-sleeved jumpsuit and soft boots, no helmet, short hair, neutral skin tone, about 14 pixels tall inside a 16x24 cell. The jumpsuit body is cream white; the collar, shoulder stripe and belt are flat pure cyan #00FFFF (this colour is replaced in the game with each crew member's colour, so it must be flat and used nowhere else). Big readable head, simple dot eyes, no mouth detail. Same character, same proportions and same size in every cell.
assets.layout: A sprite sheet: a strict grid of 6 columns x 4 rows of equal cells. One pose per cell, centred horizontally, feet on the same baseline 2 pixels above the bottom of the cell (the sleeping pose lies on that baseline). Nothing crosses a cell border.
assets.notes: Simulation activities: sleep, walk, work, meal, exercise, free, shelter, recover. 'free', 'shelter' and 'recover' reuse idle and sitting. If the lore gives each character a distinct look, this becomes four sheets.

assets.title: Astronaut, EVA suit — sprite sheet
assets.purpose: The crew outside and in the airlock: walking, cleaning panels, digging ice, carrying, climbing.

frames.order: row 1: idle x2, walk x4 | row 2: walk x2, working with a hand tool at chest height x4 | row 3: digging with a shovel x2, carrying a box x2, climbing a ladder x2

assets.background: transparent, or solid #FF00FF if transparency is not available
assets.subject: The same small astronaut wearing a bulky white Mars surface suit: round helmet with a dark gold-tinted visor, life-support backpack, thick gloves and boots. A stripe on the upper arm, a band on the helmet rim and the backpack panel are flat pure cyan #00FFFF (replaced in the game with each crew member's colour). About 15 pixels tall inside a 16x24 cell. Slightly dusty boots.
assets.layout: A sprite sheet: a strict grid of 6 columns x 3 rows of equal cells. One pose per cell, centred, feet on the same baseline 2 pixels above the bottom of the cell.
assets.notes: Attach crew.indoor as a second reference so the proportions match.

assets.title: Martian ground — tile set
assets.purpose: Everything between and around the rooms in the cutaway: surface line, soil, rock, ice.

frames.order: row 1: surface top with pebbles x3 variants, surface top with a small rock | row 2: loose reddish regolith fill x4 variants (subtle strata) | row 3: compacted darker soil x2, soil with embedded stones x2 | row 4: bedrock x2, pale blue-white ice pocket in soil x2

assets.background: opaque
assets.subject: Seamless ground tiles for a cross-section of Martian soil. Rust and orange-brown regolith with faint horizontal layers, getting darker and more violet with depth. Small stones, a few larger rocks. Ice pockets are pale blue-white crystals surrounded by soil. Each tile must tile seamlessly with the others in its row, left-right; rows blend top to bottom.
assets.layout: A strict grid of 4 columns x 4 rows of equal square tiles with no gaps and no borders between them.

assets.title: Sky — day, dusk, night
assets.purpose: Background behind the surface. The game cross-fades between the three with the Mars clock.

frames.order: row 1: day | row 2: dusk | row 3: night

assets.background: opaque
assets.subject: Three Martian skies stacked as three equal horizontal bands. DAY: butterscotch-tan sky, slightly paler near the horizon, thin high haze, small pale sun. DUSK: darker tan-grey sky with a cool blue glow around a small low sun (sunsets on Mars are blue near the Sun). NIGHT: deep violet-black sky with many small stars, two tiny moons (one a small dot, one a slightly larger irregular dot). No ground, no hills, no clouds shaped like Earth clouds. Colour changes in clean dithered bands, not smooth gradients.
assets.layout: One image divided into exactly three equal horizontal bands, each a complete sky, with a hard edge between them.
assets.notes: Science note for the artist: tan daytime sky and blue sunset are real (NASA rover images).

assets.title: Distant landscape — two parallax layers
assets.purpose: Depth behind the base: far mesas and nearer dunes.

frames.order: row 1: far layer, pale and hazy | row 2: near layer, darker and more detailed

assets.background: transparent, or solid #FF00FF if transparency is not available
assets.subject: Two horizontal bands of Martian landscape silhouettes on a transparent background. FAR: low flat-topped mesas and a distant crater rim, pale dusty orange, almost no detail. NEAR: rolling dunes, boulders and one small rocky outcrop, rust brown with a lighter top edge. Both tile seamlessly left to right. The bottom edge of each band is flat.
assets.layout: One image divided into exactly two equal horizontal bands.

assets.title: Surface modules — airlock, hub, greenhouse, command
assets.purpose: The four rooms above ground, each drawn as a cutaway with its roof.
assets.perspective: Side view cutaway: front wall removed, interior visible, floor at the bottom edge.

frames.order: airlock | surface hub | greenhouse | command module

assets.generate: wide, about 5:1 — or generate each room separately at 5:4 and name them room.surface-1 … -4
assets.background: transparent above the roofs, or solid #FF00FF if transparency is not available
assets.subject: Four small surface habitat modules side by side, each 80 wide and 64 tall, interior visible, empty of people. AIRLOCK: short metal cylinder, round outer hatch on the left wall, suit rack with two white EVA suits, a bench, amber warning light. SURFACE HUB: plain white module, a hatch in the floor with the top of a ladder, storage lockers, a wall screen. GREENHOUSE: curved glass roof with white ribs, three rows of leafy green plants in grey trays, pinkish grow-lights, a water tank. COMMAND MODULE: white module with a desk, two glowing teal screens, a chair, a radio console, a dish antenna and a small weather mast on the roof. Cream interior walls, grey metal frames, rounded corners. Each module has a thin hull about 2 pixels thick.
assets.layout: A strict row of 4 equal cells, 80x64 each. Each room fills its cell; the floor line is at the same height in all four. Roof details may rise into the top 16 pixels.
assets.notes: Rooms come from src/data/base-layout.js: airlock, hub0, greenhouse, command.

assets.title: Upper underground level — quarters, landing, galley, life support
assets.purpose: The rooms 1.5 m under the surface.

frames.order: crew quarters (2 cells wide) | upper landing with ladder | galley and gym | life support

assets.generate: very wide, about 8:1 — or generate each room separately and name them room.upper-1 … -4
assets.background: opaque interior; a 2-pixel grey metal frame around each room
assets.subject: Four underground rooms in a row, interiors visible, empty of people. CREW QUARTERS (160 wide): four bunks in two stacked pairs with blankets in red, yellow, green and blue, small reading lights, a locker, a photo on the wall. UPPER LANDING (80 wide): vertical ladder passing through floor and ceiling, a handrail, an emergency light. GALLEY AND GYM (80 wide): a small table with two stools, a food warmer, cups, and an exercise bike. LIFE SUPPORT (80 wide): two tall tanks, a tangle of neat pipes, an oxygen generator with a glowing teal window, a water recycler with a small drip tray, a control panel. Cream walls, warm ceiling strip lights, rounded corners, slightly cosier and warmer than the surface modules.
assets.layout: A strict row: one cell of 160x48 followed by three cells of 80x48. Floor line at the same height in all rooms.

assets.title: Deep underground level — shelter, landing, lab, battery room
assets.purpose: The rooms 4 m under the surface.

frames.order: storm shelter (2 cells wide) | lower landing with ladder | science lab | battery room

assets.generate: very wide, about 8:1 — or generate each room separately and name them room.deep-1 … -4
assets.background: opaque interior; a 2-pixel grey metal frame around each room
assets.subject: Four deep underground rooms in a row, interiors visible, empty of people. STORM SHELTER (160 wide): a long bench with cushions, four lockers, stacked water containers along one wall, ration boxes, a small radiation meter on the wall with a green light, a lantern. LOWER LANDING (80 wide): the bottom of the ladder, a floor grate, a wall lamp. SCIENCE LAB (80 wide): a workbench with a microscope, sample boxes of red rock, a glove box, a glowing teal analysis screen. BATTERY ROOM (80 wide): two rows of battery cabinets with small amber and green indicator lights, thick cables, a power gauge. Walls slightly darker and cooler than the upper level, thicker frames, a sense of being well protected.
assets.layout: A strict row: one cell of 160x48 followed by three cells of 80x48. Floor line at the same height in all rooms.

assets.title: Solar field — panels in three dust states
assets.purpose: Outdoor work site. The dust state shows panel cleanliness from the simulation.
assets.background: transparent, or solid #FF00FF if transparency is not available
assets.subject: A group of three tilted rectangular solar panels on short metal legs, seen from the side, standing on the ground line. Deep blue cells with a thin white grid. The same group drawn three times: CLEAN and shiny with a small highlight; DUSTY with a thin layer of orange dust dulling the blue; VERY DUSTY, almost fully covered in orange-tan dust with only hints of blue. Identical shape and position in all three.
assets.layout: A strict row of 3 equal cells, 80x48 each, the panel group in the same place in each.
assets.notes: Simulation value: systems.solarClean (1.0 clean … 0.2 very dusty).

assets.title: Rover
assets.purpose: Parked on the pad; drives off-screen to the left when someone goes exploring.

frames.order: parked | driving x3 (wheels turning, slight bounce)

assets.background: transparent, or solid #FF00FF if transparency is not available
assets.subject: A small friendly two-seat pressurised Mars rover: rounded white cabin with a large dark window, six chunky grey wheels on a rocker suspension, a small roof antenna, a sample box and a shovel strapped at the back, one orange stripe. Dusty lower half.
assets.layout: A strict row of 4 equal cells, 48x32 each, wheels on the same ground line 2 pixels above the bottom.

assets.title: Interface icons
assets.purpose: Gauges, crew stats, jobs and alerts. Replaces every temporary text label.

frames.order: row 1: oxygen (two linked bubbles), water (drop), food (apple), power (battery with bolt), radiation (trefoil), science (flask), score (trophy), star | row 2: health (heart), morale (smiling face), energy (crescent moon), nutrition (bowl), fitness (dumbbell), shelter (house under a soil arch), sun, dust cloud | row 3 (jobs): greenhouse (seedling), life support (wrench on a gear), clean panels (brush on a solar panel), explore (rover), research (microscope), build (hammer), off duty (cup), walking (boot) | row 4: solar storm warning (sun with jagged rays in a triangle), dust storm (swirl), emergency (exclamation mark in a red circle), locked (padlock), pause, play, fast forward, save (floppy disk)

assets.background: transparent, or solid #FF00FF if transparency is not available
assets.subject: A sheet of 32 small, bold, instantly readable pixel icons for a children's game interface. Each icon fills most of its 16x16 cell, has the same dark outline and the same chunky weight, and uses two or three flat colours from the palette. Friendly, rounded shapes.
assets.layout: A strict grid of 8 columns x 4 rows of equal square cells, one icon per cell, centred, nothing touching the cell edges.
assets.notes: The only asset where symbols such as an exclamation mark are allowed. Still no words.

assets.title: Interface frames — panel, buttons, gauge
assets.purpose: Panels behind text, buttons in four states, and the empty gauge bar.

frames.order: row 1: panel frame (9-slice: 8-pixel corners, plain centre), dark panel frame for alerts, speech/tip bubble frame | row 2: four buttons stacked in one cell (normal, hover, pressed, disabled; each 48x12), gauge bar frame with empty track (48x12, repeated 3 times: neutral, warning amber, danger red), large round shelter button (normal and pressed, 24x24 each)

assets.background: transparent, or solid #FF00FF if transparency is not available
assets.subject: Interface building blocks that look like friendly spacecraft control panels: cream and soft grey plates with rounded corners, a 1-pixel dark outline, a lighter top edge and a darker bottom edge, tiny rivets in the corners. Buttons are teal with a lighter top; the pressed state is 1 pixel lower and darker; the disabled state is grey. The large round shelter button is amber with a red rim, like an emergency button, with no symbol on it.
assets.layout: A strict grid of 3 columns x 2 rows of 48x48 cells.
assets.notes: All words are drawn by the game in a font, never baked into images.

assets.title: Upgrade overlays — berm, water roof, extra array, antenna
assets.purpose: Drawn on top of the surface when a build project is finished, so the player sees what they built.

frames.order: regolith berm | water-bag roof | extra solar array | storm-watch antenna

assets.background: transparent, or solid #FF00FF if transparency is not available
assets.subject: Four separate add-ons for a Mars base, each on a transparent background. REGOLITH BERM: a rounded mound of reddish soil and sandbags shaped to lie over the roof of an 80-pixel-wide module, hollow underneath. WATER-BAG ROOF: a row of plump translucent pale-blue water bags strapped over a module roof, with white straps. EXTRA SOLAR ARRAY: three tilted blue solar panels on legs, matching the existing panels. STORM-WATCH ANTENNA: a tall lattice mast with a dish, a small spinning sensor and an amber beacon light.
assets.layout: A strict row of 4 equal cells, 80x64 each. The berm and the water roof sit in the top 28 pixels of their cells so they line up with a module's roof.
assets.notes: Projects in src/sim/constants.js: berm, waterRoof, solarExpansion, stormWatch.

assets.title: Weather effects — solar storm and dust storm
assets.purpose: Full-screen overlays that make a storm visible on the surface.

frames.order: row 1-2: solar storm, 2 animation frames | row 3-4: dust storm, 2 animation frames

assets.background: transparent, or solid #FF00FF if transparency is not available
assets.subject: Semi-transparent weather overlays for the sky area. SOLAR STORM (2 frames): thin slanted streaks of pale violet and white particles raining from the upper right, sparse, with a faint violet tint; the two frames are offset so they animate. DUST STORM (2 frames): thick orange-brown haze with darker swirling bands and a few flying grains, denser at the bottom; the two frames are offset so they animate. No ground, no objects.
assets.layout: One image divided into exactly four equal horizontal bands.
assets.notes: Science note: solar storm particles are invisible in reality. The streaks are a deliberate visual metaphor and the game should say so once.

assets.title: Animated machines and plants
assets.purpose: Small animated details that show whether a system is running: drawn over the room art.

frames.order: row 1: oxygen generator window, 4 frames of bubbles rising | row 2: water recycler, 4 frames of a drip and a turning valve | row 3: plants, 4 growth stages from sprout to leafy | row 4: battery indicator, 4 charge levels from red-empty to green-full

assets.background: transparent, or solid #FF00FF if transparency is not available
assets.subject: Small animated machine details and plants for a Mars base interior, each drawn 4 times in a row. Teal glowing liquid for the oxygen generator, pale blue water for the recycler, fresh green leaves in a grey tray for the plants, an upright battery with a coloured fill bar.
assets.layout: A strict grid of 4 columns x 4 rows of equal 24x24 cells.
assets.notes: Simulation values: power.powered.o2gen / recycler / greenhouse, resources.batteryKwh.

assets.title: Event illustrations — gameplay events
assets.purpose: The picture on each event card. These six come from the simulation, so they do not depend on the lore.
assets.perspective: Small scenes; side view where a base is shown.

frames.order: row 1: solar storm warning | solar storm over the base | dust storm | row 2: dust devil cleaning the panels | life-support emergency | astronaut grounded by the flight doctor | row 3: mission complete | mission aborted | (leave empty)

assets.generate: 16:9 — or generate each scene separately at 16:9 and name them event.cards-1 … -8
assets.background: opaque
assets.subject: Eight small illustrated scenes in a grid. (1) STORM WARNING: the Sun on the left throwing off a bright curl of plasma toward a small Mars on the right, a dotted arc between them. (2) SOLAR STORM: the base seen in cutaway, pale violet particle streaks hitting the surface, astronauts safe and calm in the deep shelter. (3) DUST STORM: surface modules half hidden in orange-brown haze, solar panels barely visible, a dim brown sun. (4) DUST DEVIL: a tall twisting column of dust passing over solar panels and leaving them clean and shiny. (5) EMERGENCY: a life-support room lit red by an alarm lamp, a gauge at empty, an astronaut hurrying to a control panel. (6) GROUNDED: an astronaut sitting on a bunk with a blanket and a cup while a friendly crewmate with a tablet checks a small dosimeter badge. (7) MISSION COMPLETE: four astronauts in jumpsuits cheering in the galley around a table with a tiny plant on it. (8) MISSION ABORTED: a small ascent rocket lifting off from the surface at dusk, the base lights still on below — hopeful, not sad. The ninth cell stays empty.
assets.layout: A strict grid of 3 columns x 3 rows of equal 160x90 cells with no borders.
assets.notes: Event types in src/sim/messages.js. Nobody is shown hurt.
